snippet.title: [100% Fighter] Part 1 - Baldur’s Gate: Dark Alliance (GBA) - Walkthrough
snippet.description:
I recorded this playthrough many months ago and when the game came to me in a dream, I decided it's finally time to upload it. I wanted to record playthroughs for all classes, but for now I'm busy with life and Two Worlds (which is actually a very cool and underrated game), so for now it would be fine to at least upload the fighter playthrough.

This game is cool, if you ask me. I played it for the first time during this walkthrough and liked it a lot. It has some flaws. For example, music. The game is really quiet for the most part. Also it's a bit repetitive and I think there's no RNG in item generation in chests. For an RPG there's really not much different items and upgrade builds. But for a GBA game it's great and worths at least one playthrough, that's for sure.

At first the game might be a bit difficult, but when you understand the basic combat it becomes much easier. Also if you notice that enemies can't leave a certain area, then you can really kill them all without even giving them a chance to fight back. I think it's rather a flaw... It's not okay, when the enemy behaviour can be abused like this.

Anyway, this episode is pretty much the beginning of the story. The game isn't that long and has not that many quests, but that was the first one of them.

-----------------------------
Walkthrough playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLNGa1kVSWDk3L4jow0SRu_t_KoTO1u25d

Played on PC using mGBA emulator.
